landing.title: StuntWatch
landing.subtitle: Indonesia Stunting Risk Map
landing.description: StuntWatch is an interactive geospatial monitoring and decision-support platform mapping childhood stunting risk across all 38 provinces and 514 regencies/cities in Indonesia. Through a unified 0–100 risk index and SHAP-based factor decomposition, policymakers can drill down from national patterns to targeted district-level interventions.
